name: Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty
positioning: Urban waterfront resort on 26 acres of Bolgatty Island, overlooking the backwaters of Vembanad Lake
best_for: Travelers who want a resort setting on the Kochi backwaters
Families wanting a villa with a private kitchen and plunge pool
Couples planning a lakeside wedding or celebration

facts.text: The hotel sits on 26 acres of green land on Bolgatty Island, overlooking the backwaters of Vembanad Lake.
Rooms and suites offer lake and city views, and the accommodations include villas with plunge pools and private access.
The Grand Terrace Suite has a large living area, a walk-in wardrobe and a private terrace with views of Vembanad Lake.
Santata Spa combines Western relaxation techniques with Ayurvedic therapies.
The outdoor pool is surrounded by gardens overlooking the backwaters and includes a children's pool; there is also an indoor pool overlooking the gardens.
Grand Club access includes breakfast, appetizers, beverages and evening refreshments.
The hotel can arrange experiences such as backwater tours, food and spice trail tours and boat races.
Malabar Cafe serves an all-day menu of traditional Kerala recipes.
Thai Soul is a casual poolside restaurant with a live kitchen, inspired by the streets of Bangkok.
The hotel has more than 30 indoor and outdoor event venues, including lakeside wedding settings.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours, with cardio and strength equipment and personal trainers.

highlights.text: The hotel offers luxury houseboats on Vembanad Lake for experiencing Kochi from the water.
Chinese fishing nets, a symbol of Kochi's maritime heritage, stand on the grounds against the hotel's waterfront facade.
The Two Bedroom Villa has a spacious living room, a private kitchen and two bedrooms for a family of four and an attendant.
Santata Spa has seven treatment rooms, an indoor pool, hydrotherapy facilities and relaxation lounges.
The grounds include a yoga lawn, a spice garden and a private jetty for backwater escapes.

considerations.text: Cochin International Airport is 32 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel hosts weddings, conferences and corporate meetings across more than 30 indoor and outdoor venues.
WhataHotel notes limited nearby attractions within walking distance.
